assessments.reasoning: Printed and PDF page 139 in the hash-matched Oracle reference explicitly gives Component-variable scope through the component lifetime after declaration and requires a declaration in every PeopleCode program using it. The source also gives the function and type restrictions.

challenge.method: Inspect the declaration's restrictions and compare the same manual's Transfer, TransferExact, and TransferModeless descriptions at pp.810, 814, and 822 for possible persistence after a transfer to the same named component.
challenge.results: The Component entry directly supports the scoped lifetime and declaration statement. The transfer entries say these variables cease to be defined on those transfers even when the target is the same named component. Lifetime is interpreted within the active component context.

limitations: Declaration within a function is excluded and some types cannot be declared Component.
A transfer can leave the active context even when the destination uses the same named component. Oracle documents loss of Component variables after Transfer, TransferExact, and TransferModeless.
